data.name: Ekagratha
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ekagra’, meaning ‘one-pointed’. This name is believed to symbolize a focused and undistracted mind, often associated with deep meditation and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents inner peace and concentration.
data.numerology_meaning: Individuals with this name are natural leaders and independent thinkers. They possess a strong will and determination, often leading them to achieve great things.

in_sanskrit.name: एकाग्रथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One-pointed chariot, single-mindedness, unwavering focus, concentration

in_hindi.name: एकाग्रथ
in_hindi.meaning: एक (eka) - ek, one; आग्रथ (agratha) - vahan, vehicle
in_hindi.long_meaning: एक प्रकार के साथ वहाँ तक वह जाने वाला वहन (vehicle) के साथ एकदम संतुष्ट रहना, सिंगल मंदिर के रूप में ध्यान रखना, संतुष्ट रहना

in_tamil.name: எகாக்ரத
in_tamil.long_meaning: எகமான ரதம் (chariot) அல்லது எதிர்ப்பு மட்டும் ஏற்ற ஒன்றிடம் வந்து இருக்கும் அவருக்கு எகமான வாழ்க்கை, இடம் பெற்று இருக்கலாம், அதிகாலமாக நிழல்வனம்

in_telugu.name: ఏకాగ్రథ
in_telugu.meaning: ఏక (eka) - ఐద, ఒదో; ఆగ్రథ (agratha) - అదేశ, అద్యథన
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఒదో పేశచేదియే అదేశమై ఎకదేశిందే దేశపోయేదు, ఇదిగ్ధే దేశమేదే ఎకదేశియే, సీమెళ్లేదు

in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekagratha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ekagra’, meaning ‘one-pointed’. This name is believed to symbolize a focused and undistracted mind, often associated with deep meditation and spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ekagratha" holds a significant cultural impact in Hinduism, as it reflects the importance placed on mental focus and concentration in various spiritual practices and philosophies. In Hindu mythology, several deities, such as Lord Shiva, are often depicted in deep meditation or contemplation, emphasizing the importance of a one-pointed mind for spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name may also resonate with the ideals and virtues of focus, dedication, and determination, making it a fitting choice for individuals striving for personal growth and self-improvement.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper spiritual level, the name "Ekagratha" encourages the cultivation of one-pointed awareness or single-minded concentration. This mindset is believed to foster inner peace, purify the mind, and ultimately, lead to a higher state of consciousness. As the name suggests, having a focused mind enables individuals to devote their full attention to their chosen spiritual practice, meditation, or other aspects of their personal growth journey. In this way, the name "Ekagratha" can serve as an inspiring reminder of the transformative power of mental focus and concentration in the pursuit of spiritual growth.

historical_references.reference: Ekagratha was the name of a group of monks who lived in the forest of Chitrakoot during the 5th century BC and were known for their intense focus and devotion towards Lord Rama.

Ekagratha was also the name of a king who ruled the region of Magadha in the 3rd century BC. He is known for his unwavering devotion to Lord Mahavira and led military campaigns to protect Jain monasteries from invading armies.
